description: This file acts as a factory and registration module for generating FastAPI route handlers dynamically for container proxy endpoints based on configuration read from a JSON file. It defines functions for creating request handlers based on path parameters, accessing container configurations, processing requests (including binary content), and registering all endpoints in a router, facilitating dynamic and configurable API route setup within a FastAPI application.

methods.name: Dict _load_endpoints_config()
methods.description: Loads the container endpoint configurations from a JSON file.

methods.name: List[str] get_all_route_types()
methods.description: Returns a list of all async route names defined in the endpoints configuration.

methods.name: _get_container_provider_config(custom_llm_provider: str)
methods.description: Fetches container provider configuration based on the specified provider string.

methods.name: _create_handler_for_path_params(path_params: List[str], route_type: str, returns_binary: bool = False)
methods.description: Dynamically creates a request handler function tailored to specific URL path parameters, route type, and response type.

methods.name: _process_binary_request( request: Request, container_id: str, file_id: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Handles binary content requests, determines content type, and returns response with binary data.

methods.name: _process_request( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, route_type: str, path_params: Dict[str, str], )
methods.description: Processes standard API requests by invoking LLM request processing logic.

methods.name: None register_container_file_endpoints(router: APIRouter)
methods.description: Registers all container endpoints defined in the JSON configuration into the provided FastAPI router, handling path and method setup dynamically.
